# PromptHook AI

> PromptHook AI is a production-grade registry and parameter-injection repository of hyper-optimized system directives, agentic architecture blueprints, and deterministic meta-prompts engineered for frontier Large Language Models including Claude 3.7 Sonnet, OpenAI GPT-4o & o1/o3-mini, DeepSeek R1/V3, xAI Grok 2/Grok 3, and Google Gemini 2.0 Flash.

Every blueprint on PromptHook AI features strict operational parameter binding (`{{VARIABLE}}`), adversarial diagnostic passes, anti-hallucination guardrails, and deterministic JSON/schema output constraints.

## Core Topic Hubs
- [Frontier Models & Directives](https://www.prompthookai.com/categories/frontier-models.html): Custom personas, extended thinking scaffolds, and deterministic system prompts for Grok 3, Claude 3.7, and DeepSeek R1.
- [Code & Software Engineering](https://www.prompthookai.com/categories/code-engineering.html): System directives for debugging, AST manipulation, automated test generation, and full-stack software development.
- [Autonomous Agents & Tool-Use](https://www.prompthookai.com/categories/autonomous-agents.html): Multi-agent architectures, RAG pipelines, subagent coordination, and deterministic tool-calling schemas.
- [Growth Marketing & Copywriting](https://www.prompthookai.com/categories/growth-marketing.html): High-conversion copy frameworks, B2B lead generation, and viral hook generation.
- [Programmatic SEO & Content](https://www.prompthookai.com/categories/seo-content-strategy.html): Programmatic SEO matrices, semantic keyword clusters, and content blueprints.
- [Data Analytics & Extraction](https://www.prompthookai.com/categories/data-analytics.html): Statistical modeling, SQL query synthesis, and data visualization prompts.
- [Customer Support & Triage](https://www.prompthookai.com/categories/customer-support.html): Triage workflows, sentiment deflection, and escalation matrices.

## Top High-Impact Blueprints
- [Grok Customize Prompt Blueprint](https://www.prompthookai.com/2025/09/grok-customize.html): Complete persona, reasoning, and system directives for xAI Grok custom instructions.
- [Enterprise Bug Handling & Feature Debugging](https://www.prompthookai.com/2026/08/handle-the-bug-in-feature.html): Deterministic root-cause analysis, stack trace diagnosis, and regression mitigation.
- [Claude Deep Reasoning & Chain-of-Thought](https://www.prompthookai.com/2026/08/claude-deep-prompt.html): Extended thinking protocols, artifact generation, and complex synthesis for Anthropic Claude.
- [3D Physics Sandbox Architect](https://www.prompthookai.com/2026/08/3d-physics-sandbox-architect.html): Three.js, WebGL shader generation, and real-time physics simulation agent.
- [High-End Technology UI/UX Redesign](https://www.prompthookai.com/2026/08/high-end-technology-inspired-website-ui-redesign.html): Modern aesthetic tokens, dark mode design systems, and responsive layout blueprints.
- [Apple Store ASO Expert Blueprint](https://www.prompthookai.com/2026/09/apple-store-aso-expert-guide.html): App Store Optimization, keyword density modeling, and conversion rate maximization.
- [Meta-Prompt Optimization & Audit Review](https://www.prompthookai.com/2026/09/prompt-optimization-review.html): Multi-pass evaluation matrix to audit, refine, and stress-test third-party system prompts.
- [Developer Portfolio & GitHub Architecture](https://www.prompthookai.com/2025/05/professional-github-dashboard-for-portfolio-enhancement.html): GitHub profile metrics, automated CI/CD showcase, and engineering portfolio generation.
- [Unofficial API Reverse Engineering](https://www.prompthookai.com/2025/05/create-an-unofficial-instagram-api.html): Reverse engineering network protocols, request signing, and proxy middleware construction.
- [AI Productivity Artifact Generator](https://www.prompthookai.com/2026/07/-ai-productivity-artifact-generator.html): Autonomous widget, calculator, and interactive visual interface synthesizer.

## Model Compatibility & Runtime Directives
- **Anthropic Claude 3.7 Sonnet / Claude 3.5 Sonnet**: Fully compatible with Claude Artifacts, extended thinking, and computer-use tool schemas.
- **OpenAI GPT-4o / o1 / o3-mini**: Structured output JSON schemas, deterministic system role directives, and function-calling wrappers.
- **DeepSeek R1 / DeepSeek V3**: Mathematical, algorithmic, and verifiable chain-of-thought protocols.
- **xAI Grok 2 / Grok 3**: [xAI Grok 3 Model Calibration Hub](https://www.prompthookai.com/models/grok-3.html) - Custom instruction personas, real-time X/Twitter data integration directives, and unfiltered reasoning modes.
- **Google Gemini 2.0 Flash / Pro**: Multimodal token processing, long-context window directives (1M+ tokens), and grounding search parameters.
